scope: Proposition 5.3 (Uniform prime corank) of the manuscript “The sharp exponential rate of singularity for symmetric Bernoulli matrices” (preprints/The-sharp-exponential-rate-of-singularity-for-symmetric-Bernoulli-matrices-October-3-2026/symmetric-bernoulli-singularity.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 239 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8dfe5c0b8a0ca85c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Typically for nonsingular binary matrices B of size m ∈ IN , one has, simultaneously for every prime p, corankFp (B mod p) ≤ N3/5 . More precisely, uniformly for m ∈ IN , the probability of nonsingularity together with failure of this assertion is at most 2−Ω(N6/5).
